@graph.name: Court painting and graphics
@graph.serviceType: Court painting, court design and graphics
@graph.description: Court painting using rubber-granulated sports paints: refreshes, markings, Signature and Masters II patterns from Studio 3D, and branding.

mainEntity.name: How much does court painting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: From PLN 78/m² (one colour, primer, 2 paint coats and markings) to PLN 183/m² (7+ colour pattern on a granulated base), excluding VAT. For a 28 × 15 m court (420 m²), prices start at PLN 32,760 excluding VAT. Substrate repairs are quoted after reviewing photos.

mainEntity.name: Can an existing concrete or asphalt court be painted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, provided the surface is stable and properly prepared: cleaning, grinding, crack filling, primer and levelling layer. I assess substrate condition from photos before selecting the technology.

mainEntity.name: Do you design patterns or only paint them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. You can design your own pattern in Studio 3D (732 patterns, each with 12 variants and palettes), I can create a bespoke design or implement an approved visual identity.

mainEntity.name: Can complex patterns be painted accurately?

acceptedAnswer.text: Studio patterns are designed for painting: flat shapes only, with gradients represented by stepped bands. In Masters II each band is at least approximately 20 cm on a 15 × 10 m court, the pattern uses no more than 5 paints and is symmetrical, so both halves play the same.

mainEntity.name: Can logos be placed on the court?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Branding can appear on the playing area, boards, zones outside the court or equipment. I design it to preserve clarity of play.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide sports markings alone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Markings for football, basketball, 3v3 or multiple games, without necessarily changing the overall appearance. I select the marking colour (white, black or lime) for the best contrast with the surface.

mainEntity.name: How does rubber-granulated paint differ from standard paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a flexible rubber-modified coating providing better cushioning, slip resistance and coverage of minor cracks. I apply multicolour patterns on this base.

mainEntity.name: When can painting be carried out?

acceptedAnswer.text: On dry concrete above freezing, usually from spring to autumn. Design and quotations can be prepared earlier, including in winter.
